message:
fix(apk, sh-strength r5): the latched buffer by its own timestamp; a touch stream begun before its layout is shown is swallowed whole

Codex codex_sh_strength_r4.md N1-c1, c2.
c1: every SharpenRenderer swap carries its own presentation timestamp (SharpenOutputLog, far above decoder time),
recorded BEFORE the swap and dropped if it fails: VIDEO / REDRAW / CLEAR, the layout generation, the decoder frame.
The view's latch looks up the buffer it actually latched (SharpenLatch): never the renderer's latest swap. A CLEAR
or an unknown buffer counts as nothing (no frame, no first output, no layout shown); the decoder timestamp keeps
the handoff/latency/first-output matching. The same layout under a newer name is shown only after a redraw with it
is latched (no credit without a swap).
c2: ViewerTouchRouter decides at ACTION_DOWN: a PC stream begun while B's new layout is not shown is SWALLOW to its
final up (a second finger, moves, partial ups never send; the layout shown mid-stream does not resume it). A layout
sent during a PC stream interrupts it once (release), the rest swallowed. Local pan unchanged.
